title: tetraria cernua
intro: Tetraria cernua, commonly known as umbrella fern, is a plant species native to South Africa and is a type of aquatic fern. The health benefits of Tetraria cernua include its ability to act as a natural anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial agent, which can help alleviate symptoms of various skin and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its potential to reduce inflammation, kill bacteria, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Tetraria cernua include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
